app.name: Stratum
app.description: Supplier and food safety document control

topbar.previewHint: Sample-data preview: change the role to see what each user sees.

sample.hint: These companies, suppliers and documents are fictional. None of this data belongs to a real customer.

panel.title: Dashboard
panel.description: What needs a decision today: expirations, documents to review and pending suppliers.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Manufacturers and distributors, their ingredients and the status of their file.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Certificates and documents to review, current, expiring and missing.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Documents requested from suppliers, with their reminders and due dates.

history.title: History
history.description: Who did what, when and why, on every supplier and document.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Company details, users, roles and the document catalog.

home.title: Choose a company
home.description: Each company has its own space. Your data never mixes with another company's.

errors.body: We couldn't show this page. Please try again. If the problem continues, email soporte@stratumpr.com with this code.
errors.notFoundBody: The address doesn't exist or is no longer available.

review.title: Component review
review.description: Every piece of the design system, to approve the look before building real screens.
review.bodySample: Stratum keeps every supplier's certificates current, requests the missing ones and warns you before they expire.
